pages.text: Every recipe is in this book, on the page about what it makes, and everything is in the $(thing)Reiko's Trains$() creative tab.$(br2)With $(thing)JEI$() installed, each of the mod's items has an information page too, and there are pages for what the locomotives run on and what the track-laying wagon fills dips with ($(l:more/jei)JEI$(/l)).
